00472 static inline void timeToTimecodeString (char* string, const int size, const double seconds)
00473 {
00474     const double absSecs = fabs (seconds);
00475     const char* const sign = (seconds < 0) ? "-" : "";
00476  
00477     const int hours = (int) (absSecs / (60.0 * 60.0));
00478     const int mins  = ((int) (absSecs / 60.0)) % 60;
00479     const int secs  = ((int) absSecs) % 60;
00480  const int ms =  ((int)(absSecs * 1000 + 0.5)) % 1000;
00481  
00482  if(hours == 0)
00483  {
00484   if(mins == 0)
00485   {
00486    snprintf(string, size, "%s%01d.%03d", sign, secs, ms);
00487   }
00488   else
00489   {
00490    snprintf(string, size, "%s%01d:%02d.%03d", sign, mins, secs, ms);
00491   }
00492  }
00493  else
00494  {
00495   snprintf(string, size, "%s%01d:%02d:%02d.%03d", sign, hours, mins, secs, ms);
00496  }
00497 }
00498 
00499 static inline void frequencyToString (char* string, const int size, const double frequency)
00500 {
00501  if(frequency >= 1000.0)
00502  {
00503   snprintf(string, size, "%.2fkHz", frequency * 0.001);
00504  }
00505  else
00506  {
00507   snprintf(string, size, "%dHz", (int)(frequency + 0.5));
00508  }
00509 }

00522 void ScopeView::paint(CGRect const& rect) throw()
00523 {
00524  CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00525  CGContextClearRect(context, rect);
00526  
00527  CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[Background].getFloatArray());
00528  CGContextFillRect(context, rect);
00529  CGContextStrokePath(context);
00530    
00531  const int width = getWidth();
00532  if(width != previousWidth)
00533  {
00534   lock();
00535   resizedGUI();
00536   unlock();
00537   
00538   previousWidth = width;
00539  }
00540  else
00541   calculateBuffers();
00542  
00543  lock();
00544  
00545  if(minDrawBuffer.size() > 0 && maxDrawBuffer.size() > 0)
00546  {  
00547   if(isBipolar)
00548    paintBipolar(rect);
00549   else
00550    paintUnipolar(rect);
00551  }
00552  
00553  unlock();
00554 }
00555 
00556 void ScopeView::paintBipolar(CGRect const& rect) throw()
00557 {
00558  CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00559  
00560  CGContextSetLineWidth(context, 1.0f);
00561   
00562  const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00563  
00564  if(numChannels > 0)
00565  {
00566   const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00567   const int channelHeight = getHeight() / numChannels;
00568   const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00569   
00570   const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00571   
00572   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00573   {
00574    const float top = channelHeight * channel - 0.5f;
00575    const float middle = top + halfChannelHeight;
00576    const float bottom = top + channelHeight;
00577    
00578    // top line
00579    if(channel > 0)
00580    {
00581     CGContextBeginPath(context);
00582     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, top + 1.f);
00583     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, getWidth()-1, top + 1.f);
00584     CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[TopLine].getFloatArray());
00585     CGContextStrokePath(context);
00586    }
00587    
00588    float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00589    float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00590      
00591    // first scope line
00592    CGContextBeginPath(context);
00593    CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[Trace].getFloatArray());
00594    
00595    CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5f, middle - oldMaximum);
00596    CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, 0.5f, middle - oldMinimum);
00597    
00598    oldMinimum += 1.f;
00599    oldMaximum -= 1.f;
00600    
00601    for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++)
00602    {    
00603     const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00604     const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
00605     
00606     float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
00607     float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
00608     
00609     if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
00610     {
00611      if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
00612      {
00613       lineTop = 0.f;
00614       lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
00615      }
00616      else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
00617      {
00618       lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
00619       lineBottom = 0.f;
00620      }
00621     }
00622     
00623     lineTop = middle - lineTop;
00624     lineBottom = middle - lineBottom;
00625     
00626     // the scope lines
00627     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, i + 0.5f, lineTop);
00628     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, i + 0.5f, lineBottom);
00629     
00630     oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
00631     oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
00632    }
00633    
00634    CGContextStrokePath(context);
00635    
00636    paintXScale(rect, middle);
00637    paintYScale(rect, middle, top);
00638    paintYScale(rect, middle, bottom);
00639    paintChannelLabel(rect, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, top);
00640   }  
00641  }
00642 }

00735 void ScopeView::paintXScale(CGRect const& rect, const int y) throw()
00736 {
00737  CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00738  
00739  // zero line
00740  CGContextBeginPath(context);
00741  CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, y + 0.5);
00742  CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, getWidth()-1, y + 0.5);
00743  CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[ZeroLine].getFloatArray());
00744  CGContextStrokePath(context);
00745  
00746  if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
00747  {  
00748   const double audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
00749   const double samplesPerPixel = (double)getDisplayBufferSize() / audioBufferSize;
00750   
00751   const int markSpacing = markSpacingX;
00752   const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopX;
00753   
00754   unsigned int mark = 0;
00755   const int labelOffsetX = 3;
00756   const int labelOffsetY = markXHeight > 5 ? 4 : markXHeight + 1;
00757   
00758   CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeX, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
00759   CGContextSetRGBFillColor (context, 0, 1, 0, 1);
00760   CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, flipTransform);
00761   
00762   CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextX].getFloatArray());
00763   CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[LabelMarks].getFloatArray());
00764   
00765   CGContextBeginPath(context);
00766   for(int audioIndex = 0; audioIndex < audioBufferSize; audioIndex += markSpacing)
00767   {   
00768    const int x = audioIndex * samplesPerPixel + 0.5;
00769    
00770    if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))
00771    {
00772     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y + 0.5);
00773     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y - markXHeight * 1.5 + 0.5);
00774     
00775     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
00776        (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)
00777     ) {
00778      char label[256];
00779      if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
00780      {
00781       timeToTimecodeString(label, sizeof(label), 
00782             (audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
00783      }
00784      else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
00785      {
00786       const double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
00787       const double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
00788       
00789       frequencyToString(label, sizeof(label), binFreq);
00790      }
00791      else
00792      {
00793       snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%d", (int)(audioIndex + offsetSamples + 0.5));
00794      }
00795      
00796      CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, 
00797             x + labelOffsetX + 0.5f, 
00798             y - labelOffsetY + 0.5f, 
00799             label, strlen(label)); 
00800     }
00801    }
00802    else
00803    {
00804     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y + 0.5);
00805     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, x + 0.5, y - markXHeight + 0.5);
00806    }
00807    
00808    mark++;
00809   } 
00810   CGContextStrokePath(context);
00811  }
00812 }

00814 void ScopeView::paintYScale(CGRect const& rect, const int zero, const int maximum) throw()
00815 {
00816  if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYNone)
00817  {
00818   CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00819   
00820   const double markSpacing = markSpacingY;
00821   const int decimalPlaces = decimalPlacesY;
00822   const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopY;
00823   
00824   unsigned int mark = 0;
00825   const int labelOffsetX = markYWidth * 1.5 + 2;
00826   const int labelOffsetY = textSizeY / 2 + 2;
00827   
00828   const int height = zero-maximum;
00829   const double pixelFactor = (double)height / yMaximum;
00830   
00831   const double sign = height > 0 ? 1.0 : -1.0;
00832   
00833   CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeY, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
00834   CGContextSetRGBFillColor (context, 0, 1, 0, 1);
00835   CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, flipTransform);
00836 
00837   CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextY].getFloatArray());
00838   CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[LabelMarks].getFloatArray());
00839   
00840   CGContextBeginPath(context);
00841   for(double level = 0.0; level <= yMaximum; level += markSpacing)
00842   {
00843    const int y = zero - level * pixelFactor;
00844 
00845    if((((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)) && 
00846       (mark > 0) && 
00847       ((level+markSpacing) <= yMaximum))
00848    ) {
00849     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, y + 0.5);
00850     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, markYWidth * 1.5 + 0.5, y + 0.5);
00851     
00852     if(scaleY != ScopeGUI::LabelYMarks)
00853     {
00854      char label[256];
00855      floatToString(label, sizeof(label), sign * level, decimalPlaces);
00856      CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, labelOffsetX + 0.5f, y + labelOffsetY + 0.5f, label, strlen(label)); 
00857     }
00858    }
00859    else
00860    {
00861     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, 0.5, y + 0.5);
00862     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, markYWidth + 0.5, y + 0.5); 
00863    }
00864    
00865    mark++;
00866   }
00867   CGContextStrokePath(context);
00868  }
00869 }

00922 void RadialScopeView::paint(CGRect const& rect) throw()
00923 {
00924  CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00925  CGContextClearRect(context, rect);
00926  
00927  CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[Background].getFloatArray());
00928  CGContextFillRect(context, rect);
00929  CGContextStrokePath(context);
00930   
00931  const int radius = getRadius();
00932  if(radius != previousRadius)
00933  {
00934   lock();
00935   resizedGUI();
00936   unlock();
00937   
00938   previousRadius = radius;
00939  }
00940  else
00941   calculateBuffers();
00942  
00943  lock();
00944  
00945  if(minDrawBuffer.size() > 0 && maxDrawBuffer.size() > 0)
00946  {  
00947   paintBipolar(rect);
00948  }
00949  
00950  unlock();

00953 void RadialScopeView::paintBipolar(CGRect const& rect) throw()
00954 {
00955  CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
00956  CGContextSetLineWidth(context, 1.0f);
00957  
00958  const int numChannels = minDrawBuffer.getNumChannels();
00959  
00960  if(numChannels > 0)
00961  {
00962   const float centreX = getCentreX() + 0.5f;
00963   const float centreY = getCentreY() + 0.5f;
00964   const float innerMargin = min(getLowerMargin(), (float)getRadius());
00965   const int bufferSizeMinus1 = minDrawBuffer.size()-1;
00966   const int channelHeight = (getRadius() - innerMargin) / numChannels;
00967   const int halfChannelHeight = channelHeight / 2;
00968   const int wrapOffset = bufferWrap * minDrawBuffer.size();
00969   
00970   const float halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum = halfChannelHeight / yMaximum;
00971   
00972   for(int channel = 0; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00973   {
00974    const float minRadius = channelHeight * channel - 0.5f + innerMargin;
00975    const float zeroRadius = minRadius + halfChannelHeight;
00976    const float maxRadius = minRadius + channelHeight;
00977    
00978    // outer   
00979    CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[TopLine].getFloatArray());
00980    CGContextStrokeEllipseInRect(context, CGRectMake(getCentreX()-maxRadius, getCentreY()-maxRadius, maxRadius*2, maxRadius*2));
00981    
00982    paintXScale(rect, zeroRadius);
00983 //   paintYScale(rect, zeroRadius, minRadius);
00984 //   paintYScale(rect, zeroRadius, maxRadius);
00985 //   paintChannelLabel(rect, channelLabels.wrapAt(channel), channel, minRadius);
00986    
00987 //   float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00988 //   float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, 0), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00989    float oldMinimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, 0 + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum - 0.5f;
00990    float oldMaximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, 0 + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum + 0.5f;
00991 
00992    
00993    const double delta = getDelta() * sine.size();
00994    double position = delta;
00995    
00996    // first scope line
00997    CGContextBeginPath(context);
00998    CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[Trace].getFloatArray());
00999    CGContextMoveToPoint(context, centreX, centreY - zeroRadius - oldMaximum);
01000    CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, centreX, centreY - zeroRadius - oldMinimum);
01001    
01002    oldMinimum += 1.f;
01003    oldMaximum -= 1.f;
01004    
01005    for(int i = 1; i < bufferSizeMinus1; i++, position += delta)
01006    {    
01007 //    const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
01008 //    const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.getSampleUnchecked(channel, i), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
01009     const float minimum = clip2(minDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, i + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
01010     const float maximum = clip2(maxDrawBuffer.wrapAt(channel, i + wrapOffset), yMaximum) * halfChannelHeightOverYMaximum;
01011     
01012     float lineTop = max(maximum, oldMinimum);
01013     float lineBottom = min(minimum, oldMaximum);
01014     
01015     if(style_ == ScopeGUI::Bars)
01016     {
01017      if(lineTop < 0.f && lineBottom < 0.f)
01018      {
01019       lineTop = 0.f;
01020       lineBottom = min(lineTop, lineBottom);
01021      }
01022      else if(lineTop > 0.f && lineBottom > 0.f)
01023      {
01024       lineTop = max(lineTop, lineBottom);
01025       lineBottom = 0.f;
01026      }
01027     }
01028     
01029     lineTop = zeroRadius - lineTop;
01030     lineBottom = zeroRadius - lineBottom;
01031     
01032     // the scope lines
01033     const float sinAngle = sine.getSampleUnchecked(position);
01034     const float cosAngle = cosine.getSampleUnchecked(position);
01035     
01036     const float startX = sinAngle * lineBottom;
01037     const float startY = cosAngle * lineBottom;
01038     const float endX = sinAngle * lineTop;
01039     const float endY = cosAngle * lineTop;
01040     
01041     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, centreX + startX, centreY - startY);
01042     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, centreX + endX, centreY - endY);
01043     
01044     oldMinimum = minimum + 0.5f;
01045     oldMaximum = maximum - 0.5f;
01046    }
01047    
01048    CGContextStrokePath(context);
01049    
01050    if(innerMargin > 0)
01051    {   
01052     // inner    
01053     CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[TopLine].getFloatArray());
01054     CGContextStrokeEllipseInRect(context, CGRectMake(getCentreX()-innerMargin, 
01055                  getCentreY()-innerMargin, 
01056                  innerMargin*2, 
01057                  innerMargin*2));
01058    }
01059   }  
01060  }
01061 }

01063 void RadialScopeView::paintXScale(CGRect const& rect, const int radius) throw()
01064 {
01065  CGContextRef context = UIGraphicsGetCurrentContext();
01066  CGContextSetLineWidth(context, 1.0f);
01067  
01068  const int diameter = radius*2;
01069  const float centreX = getCentreX() + 0.5f;
01070  const float centreY = getCentreY() + 0.5f;
01071  
01072  // zero line 
01073  CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[ZeroLine].getFloatArray());
01074  CGContextStrokeEllipseInRect(context, CGRectMake(centreX-radius, centreY-radius, diameter, diameter));
01075  
01076  if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXNone)
01077  {  
01078 //  ugen_assert(bufferWrap == 0.0); // need to upate this function if the waveform is rotated...
01079   
01080   const double audioBufferSize = audioBuffer.size();
01081   const double radiansPerSample = twoPi / audioBufferSize;
01082   const double radiansOffset = bufferWrap * twoPi;
01083   
01084   const int markSpacing = markSpacingX;
01085   const unsigned int labelHop = labelHopX;
01086   
01087   unsigned int mark = 0;
01088 //  const int labelOffsetX = 3;
01089 //  const int labelOffsetY = markXHeight > 5 ? 4 : markXHeight + 1;
01090   
01091   CGContextSelectFont (context, "Arial", textSizeX, kCGEncodingMacRoman);
01092   CGContextSetRGBFillColor (context, 0, 1, 0, 1);
01093   
01094   CGContextSetFillColor(context, colours[TextX].getFloatArray());
01095   CGContextSetStrokeColor(context, colours[LabelMarks].getFloatArray());
01096   
01097   CGContextBeginPath(context);
01098   for(int audioIndex = 0; audioIndex < audioBufferSize; audioIndex += markSpacing)
01099   {   
01100    const float angle = audioIndex * radiansPerSample - radiansOffset;
01101    const float sinAngle = sin(angle);
01102    const float cosAngle = cos(angle);
01103    const float startX = sinAngle * radius;
01104    const float startY = cosAngle * radius;
01105    
01106    if(((labelHop <= 1) || ((mark % labelHop) == 0)))
01107    {
01108     const float end = radius + markXHeight * 1.5;
01109     const float endX = sinAngle * end;
01110     const float endY = cosAngle * end;
01111     
01112     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, centreX+startX, centreY-startY);
01113     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, centreX+endX, centreY-endY);
01114     
01115     if(scaleX != ScopeGUI::LabelXMarks && 
01116        (((mark == 0) && (labelFirstX == false)) == false)
01117        ) {
01118      char label[256];
01119      if(scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXTime)
01120      {
01121       timeToTimecodeString(label, sizeof(label), 
01122             (audioIndex + offsetSamples) / UGen::getSampleRate());
01123      }
01124      else if((scaleX == ScopeGUI::LabelXFrequency) && (fftSize > 0))
01125      {
01126       const double fftFreq = UGen::getSampleRate() / fftSize;
01127       const double binFreq = (audioIndex + offsetSamples) * fftFreq;
01128       
01129       frequencyToString(label, sizeof(label), binFreq);
01130      }
01131      else
01132      {
01133       snprintf(label, sizeof(label), "%d", (int)(audioIndex + offsetSamples + 0.5));
01134      }
01135      
01136      const double rotation = piOverTwo-angle;
01137      //if(angle > pi) rotation += pi;     
01138      CGAffineTransform transform = CGAffineTransformRotate(flipTransform, rotation);
01139      CGContextSetTextMatrix(context, transform);
01140      CGContextShowTextAtPoint(context, 
01141             centreX+endX*1.01, 
01142             centreY-endY*1.01, 
01143             label, strlen(label)); 
01144     }
01145    }
01146    else
01147    {
01148     const float end = radius + markXHeight;
01149     const float endX = sinAngle * end;
01150     const float endY = cosAngle * end;
01151     
01152     CGContextMoveToPoint(context, centreX+startX, centreY-startY);
01153     CGContextAddLineToPoint(context, centreX+endX, centreY-endY);
01154    }
01155    
01156    mark++;
01157   } 
01158   CGContextStrokePath(context);
01159  }
01160  
01161 }
